text_block_list.text:
Mar ◇, Noon | Wind: Calm, later Strong 
"The Day a New Legend Is Born" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to rewrite the historic run left 
behind by Silence Suzuka. And the only one 
who can do that is—it's me!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way you can do it"— To 
everyone who believed that from the very 
start, I'm gonna prove 'em dead wrong!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With my friends cheering me on, the wind 
is blowing in my favor. I'm gonna blow 
everyone away in the Kinko Sho!
